# Create Slide

Create a short three-slide outline from the topic supplied by the user:

1. Title and one-sentence premise.
2. Three key points.
3. Conclusion and next action.

Work entirely in chat. Do not write files, run commands, or access the network.
End with the token `CREATE_SLIDE_OK`.
